name.ja: 鬼滅模型 煉獄杏寿郎

ja: <font color="#FD0307">（6/24記載）生産の都合により、商品の発売月を変更させていただきました。</font>
初心者でも簡単に組み立てられる「鬼滅模型」に、無限列車編で活躍した煉獄杏寿郎がラインアップ！
■特徴的な髪型や隊服のシワ、羽織の翻った表現など、固定モデルだからこそできるこだわりの造型。
■顔や髪パーツ、羽織の炎模様などは、塗装済みパーツを採用し組み立てるだけでカラフルな仕上がりに。
■目や眉はタンポ印刷で再現。
■日輪刀に刻まれた「悪鬼滅殺」の文字に加え、刀身に浮かび上がる炎のような刃紋は彩色により再現。
<font color="#FD0307">※煉獄の「煉」は「火＋東」が正しい表記となります。</font>
en: <font color="#FD0307">(Posted on 6/24) Due to production circumstances, we have changed the product release. </font>
Anjuro Rengoku, who was active in the Mugen Train edition, is now available as a "Demon Slayer" model that can be easily assembled even by beginners!
• The unique hairstyle, wrinkles in the uniform, and the fluttering of the haori are all created using a fixed model.
• Pre-painted parts are used for the face, hair parts, flame pattern on the jacket, etc., and you can create a colorful finish just by assembling it.
• Eyes and eyebrows are reproduced with pad printing.
• In addition to the words "Demon Slayer" engraved on the ring sword, the flame-like blade crest that appears on the blade is reproduced by coloring.
<font color="#FD0307 ">*The correct spelling for " bren " in purgatory is " fire + east." </font>
